fcgi_app.description: Absolute path to the FastCGI application binary.

chdir.description: Directory to change to before spawning the application.

socket_path.description: Path to the Unix domain socket to bind to. If empty, TCP binding is used.

tcp_host.description: IPv4/IPv6 address to bind to for TCP connections.

socket_mode.description: File mode of the Unix domain socket (octal integer).

umask.description: Umask to set for the spawned process.

max_requests.description: Number of requests a child processes handles before it dies.

extra_options.description: Additional arguments to pass to the FastCGI application.
